test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie chart shows the distribution (in terms of central angles) of the number of professors in six different departments of a college.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f06ac96193a465e3fd00129d00a41dc8d5aac02cd639b850f2df4e3ddee1ba67.png] 

The number of professors in Economics and Mathematics is approximately (correct up to two decimal places) what per cent more than the number of professors in English and Statistics?
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ 360° = 600

⇒ 1° = 600/360 = 5/3

Total number of Professor in Economics = 86.4 × (5/3) = 144

Total number of Professor in Mathematics = 72 × (5/3) = 120

Sum of professor in Economics and mathematics = 144 + 120 = 264

Total number of Professor in English = 50.4 × (5/3) = 84

Total number of Professor in Statistics = 43.2 × (5/3) = 72

Sum of professor in English and Statistics = 84 + 72 = 156

Required percentage = {(264 - 156) × 100}/156 

⇒ 10800/156 = 900/13 = 69.23%

**∴ The correct answer is 69.23%.**
